shared_elements: heavy raised brow ridge / eyebrow arch above eye
carving in the round of a head-and-upper-body figure
justification: Both depict a monumental, highly schematic anthropomorphic head in the round with a flat-topped blocky cranium, a heavy continuous brow ridge arching over the eye and a long straight projecting nose above a squared jaw, and both continue into a shoulder/torso mass rather than being isolated faces. The chief difference in depicted content is that B carries additional incised motifs (linear and curvilinear designs) across the back of the head and over the shoulders/back, while A shows only the plain modelled brow-eye-nose forms with no secondary imagery visible.
